subject.title: fix(sessions_send): omit misleading delivery.status from async A2A responses (#96020)

question: Should normal async `sessions_send` A2A responses omit `delivery` metadata, or should OpenClaw expose explicit status values for those paths?
rationale: Two open PRs fix the same stale pending-status bug with different user-visible response contracts, and the choice affects compatibility for tool-response consumers.

options.title: Adopt omission contract
options.body: Use this PR's direction after it preserves current failure-notification behavior and supplies real OpenClaw proof.

options.title: Prefer explicit statuses
options.body: Use the sibling status-based direction only if maintainers define those statuses as observable admission or reply states and update proof/docs accordingly.

options.title: Keep pending for now
options.body: Pause both fixes if compatibility with `delivery.status="pending"` matters more than removing misleading metadata immediately.

recommendation.title: Adopt omission contract
recommendation.body: Use this PR's direction after it preserves current failure-notification behavior and supplies real OpenClaw proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the clearest historical sessions_send semantics trail and is a suitable owner for the response-contract choice.
